sent: This is a normal heartbeat. [pause 0.3] The S-A node fires, the signal travels down through the A-V node, and both ventricles squeeze together. [pause 0.45] Now watch what happens in P-E-A, pulseless electrical activity. [pause 0.35] The electrical signal still fires, so the monitor shows an organized rhythm. [pause 0.35] But the heart isn't moving enough blood to make a pulse. [pause 0.4] The rhythm can look almost normal. [pause 0.35] But there's no pulse. [pause 0.45] P-E-A is not shockable. [pause 0.35] Start CPR, give epinephrine as soon as possible, and look for the cause. [pause 0.5] Practice it on A-C-L-S med Sim. [pause 0.35] A-C-L-S med dot com. [pause 1.2]
